SAT introduces four interrelated fields whose geometric relations reproduce key constants of nature and Standard Model structures without free parameters.  

Although I had originally intended to delay submission until the full theory could be more extensively validated and its predictions empirically tested, the recent publication of Bruno Bourgoin’s work on quantum filament topology provided strong impetus to ensure that subsequent developments in this domain would not be perceived as derivative.
